entities.summary: M. Kula Segaran s/o V. Murugeson, commonly known as Kula, is a Malaysian politician and lawyer. He has served as Deputy Minister in the Prime Minister's Department in charge of Laws and Institutional Reforms in the Unity Government under Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim and Minister Azalina Othman Said since December 2023. He has represented Ipoh Barat in the Dewan Rakyat since 2004.
